description: UI Redesign v2 — full visual and navigational redesign of GAC Reservations on top of the working v1 app: bright baby-blue/beige identity, a persistent app shell, a mobile-first resource-day calendar with a progressive desktop grid, one consistent component kit, and three additive subsystems (notifications, room-management CRUD, usage reports). Source: tasks/prd-ui-redesign-v2.md and prd_plans/UI-Redesign-Spec.md.
